etfRules._comment: How every simulated ETF trade is priced (buys and sells alike). The order is placed on its plan date and executes as a market-on-close trade: the exchange's official closing price of the first trading session on or after the order date (the close is set at 3:30 pm IST from the weighted average of the last 30 minutes of trading). Exchange holidays, weekends and days the ETF did not trade roll to the next session. Whole units only, within the budget including cash carried from earlier buys; charges per etfFees; units credited T+1. Every fill records this rule id and the audit checks each trade against it.

etfFees._comment: Delivery (CNC) trades. Resident: zero-brokerage discount broker. NRI: NRI demat + PIS account, brokerage 0.1% of value (min ₹20, max ₹100) — typical NRI desks charge more than resident accounts. Statutory: STT only on selling equity-oriented ETFs; stamp duty on buys; exchange, SEBI and investor-protection charges both sides; GST on brokerage + exchange + SEBI; DP charge per ETF per sell day.

sellRules._comment: Monthly sell review on the schedule's anchor day (next trading day). The agents follow it exactly: the engine places the sales it decides. Severe (fund / ETF no longer listed — merged or wound up): sell everything now, whatever the tax and exit load (units still in an ELSS lock-in wait). Weak (no longer the model portfolio's choice for its role for droppedStreak reviews in a row; a paused 0% slot is not 'dropped'): never in the account's first minHoldMonths; after that sell FIFO lots only once each is free of exit load and past the short-term tax period (equity / listed ETFs > 365 days, gold / international fund-of-funds > 730 days; debt any time), in Jan–Mar keeping equity long-term gains within the yearly exemption (rest waits for April); a holding flagged for deferMaxMonths is sold anyway. Proceeds switch into the model's current choice for that role.

taxHarvest._comment: Once a financial year, on the first trading day on/after 10 March, every agent harvests tax with the same rules a careful investor would use. The yearly equity LTCG exemption is per person, so the MF and ETF accounts share it (MF first). Gain harvesting: sell long-term, exit-load-free, unlocked equity lots (FIFO) whose gains fit in the person's unused exemption and buy the same fund / ETF back with the proceeds (higher cost basis, fresh holding period). Loss harvesting: if the person has taxable realised gains this year, sell equity lots standing at a loss (up to those gains) and buy them back. Done only when the tax saved beats the round-trip costs (stamp duty, STT, ETF brokerage / DP) and the gain is at least minGain.

daily._comment: Daily portfolio summary journal (store['days']). Market moves are the official closes of these index-tracking ETFs; look-through sector exposure (from the funds' latest monthly portfolios) is linked to the tracker of the same sector (names matched case-insensitively).

dipRule._comment: Market-dip lump sums (shared by the Portfolio Simulator pages and the agents). Each segment's fall = how far its index tracker's official close is below its highest close of the last `lookback` sessions. A buy fires on the day the fall first reaches a deeper tier in the current fall (tiers reset once the index is back within `resetPct` of its high), after 26 checks. Amount by tier, never below `min` or above `max`. Agents in `persons` hold `reserve` per account in a liquid fund (MF) / liquid ETF (ETF) and buy only from it.
